senses.gloss: conj. (= הוֹעִיל, v. יָעַל) [it helps, or help,] followed by ו־, because, since.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:7">Ab. Zar. III, 7</cite> <he>ה׳ ולצורה וכ׳</he> since they worship the figure (but not the tree).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:1:3">Y. Shek. III, beg. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ואילו וכ׳</he> since they say so and the others &c.; a. v. fr.—Also in Chald. phrases.
<cite ref="Targum Jerusalem, Genesis 18:17">Targ. Y. II, Gen. XVIII, 17</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 22a:9">Yeb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ ואתו לידן</he> since we are at these subjects.
<cite ref="Beitzah 18b:4">Bets. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳ ובשבת שרי וכ׳</he> since it is allowed on the Sabbath, it is also allowed on Yom Kippur.
Ib. ומי אית ליה לרבא ה׳ does Raba adopt the principle of hoïl (because something is permitted in one case, the permission must be extended to all analogous cases)?; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Yevamot 117a:7">Yeb. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>ה׳ דלא ידעה וכ׳</he> it helps (we believe her that her husband is dead), for she did not know &c. (marginal correction <he>משום</he>).
